chief.text: Hi Alex—what would you like Chief of Staff to help with?
what does this week look like?

chief.markdown:
three things matter this week:

1. **Board deck** is due Thursday. Finance has the October close ready; I booked you 2 hours Wednesday morning.
2. **Helix Labs renewal.** Usage is down 30%. Sales has a call with them Tuesday at 2.
3. **Hiring.** Two final-round candidates for the design role, Tuesday and Friday.

I moved the vendor sync to next week to make room.

chief.detail:
To: vendor-team@example.com
“Moving our sync to next Tuesday, same time.”
Keep my week to three priorities. Ask before sending anything outside the team.

launch.text: @Researcher what did customers say about the new pricing this week? @Writer turn it into a short changelog note when it's in.

launch.markdown:
read 214 support threads, 37 sales calls and the pricing survey.

1. **Annual discount lands.** 31% of new Team signups picked annual, up from 12%.
2. **Seat math confuses people.** 18 tickets asked whether guests count as seats.
3. **Business plan is underpriced** for teams over 40, per four sales calls.

Sources are in the thread notes.

draft for the changelog:

> **Clearer seats, same prices.** Guests never count as seats, and the billing page now shows exactly who does. Annual plans still save two months.

want it shorter, or should @Sales check it against the Business tier notes first?

launch.text: looks good. @Sales sanity check the business tier bit
